data.one_liner: Display angled banners in any corner of your content.
data.what_it_does: It provides widgets like CornerBanner and BuiltWithFlutterCornerBanner to overlay angled banners onto content. The banner automatically shrinks or expands to fit the provided content.
use_when: You need to show alpha or beta status banners on your app UI.
You want to display a 'Built with Flutter' badge in a corner.
avoid_when: You need standard bottom or top full-width alert banners instead of corner ribbons.
strengths: Easy to use with custom corner positioning.
weaknesses: Very early version (0.0.1) acting as a proof-of-concept.
